title: Raid Boss
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Find and remove the Forerat from the Not the Rumored Refinery off of Level 4 of Algernon. When the task is complete, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Find and remove the Forerat from the Not the Rumored Refinery off of Level 4 of Algernon. When the task is complete, return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

So the Mutants are being controlled by the Rattle Family to refine their mined Fizz Rock. And here I thought they were getting a better deal. Sounds to me like the Mutants need a better union. But that's their problem, well one of them. You are about to become their newest problem! I want you to head down into the Not the Rumored Refinery off of Level 4 of Algernon and take out their Forerat. You may have run into him before, he's kind of a big deal.

If you take out the Forerat, come back and see me, the Townston Commander. By the way, do you think you will succeed? How sure are you? Thirty percent? Forty? No reasons, these are standard questions.

Turn-in:

Oh. I see you're back. Well there goes my entry in the betting pool. The Townston Lieutenant is never going to let me live this one down. Well, you may as well take this as a reward. Good job and all that.

Bluenose.

Objectives:

  • Whisker Forerat removed

Client level range: 10–20
